preregistration.classification: pre-registered current-PIT platform and paired Monte Carlo revalidation of the frozen hold-30 candidate; research-only

5x.role: diagnostic warning only; never a hard rejection

decision_rules: Verify every R381 input and engine hash before reading any R385 portfolio performance.
Run all 27 alpha cells at 2x and 3x with the current engine and current PIT inputs; do not reuse R371, R374, R379 or R380 curves.
Use the same A/C sleeve curves for a given cost across alpha cells and rerun every B cell rather than interpolating.
The seven-cell hold-30 platform passes only if every cell passes both 2x and 3x point gates and at least three of four rolling one-year windows are positive.
The broad 27-cell grid passes only if its overall and every marginal parameter-level 2x pass rate clear the preregistered thresholds.
The Monte Carlo passes only if the full and sealed pass rates and paired sealed advantage rate each clear 75%.
Never change thresholds or reselect parameters after seeing R385 results.
5x is reported as a warning only and must not reject an otherwise passing no-leverage candidate.
A complete pass may set status candidate_for_paper_trading_review only; it does not generate paper targets, orders or production configuration.
Any failure records negative knowledge and keeps the result research-only.

ablation.role: diagnostic; uses actual current-PIT sleeve curves

broad_grid.reason: The broad grid tests whether the local neighbourhood is a plateau rather than one isolated cell. The platform itself is stricter and must pass every selected cell.

monte_carlo.method: Latin hypercube over five portfolio-construction parameters; each sample is applied identically to the centre and control

walkforward.role: diagnostic; determines whether ex-ante parameter selection adds value. The fixed centre remains the default unless a preregistered selector beats both the fixed centre and trailing-best policy on mean and worst forward return.
